name: Softstep
description: Inhabits leg augments and noise-dampening systems. Reduces the user's acoustic signature below what the hardware specifications allow.
observed_behavior: Adjusts servo timing to minimize mechanical noise. Syncs footfall with ambient sound patterns to mask movement.
story_hooks: A runner realizes they're moving quieter than their chrome should allow — and starts relying on it
Softstep goes silent during a critical stealth approach, forcing the user to rely on skill alone
